flag.name: ownershipGuard (PaddleSelectionOptions.ownershipGuard)
flag.note: Default OFF preserves existing behavior exactly; all behavior changes are behind the flag.

fixtures: All adversarial fixtures are SYNTHETIC geometry (clearly labeled in packages/swing-lab/test/paddleOwnershipRedTeam.test.ts); gold replay threads synthetic tracks through COMMITTED wave-C ownership label points with REAL people.json wrist series (src/ownershipGuardBench.ts).

breaks.scenario: partner paddle closer than own (non-decisive margin)
breaks.break: Other wrist ~0.89x of target wrist distance sits inside the dead zone of the decisive otherOwnershipFactor=0.85 gate; selector returns confident 'tracked' with zero risks.
breaks.fix: ownership-guard-v1 abstains ('paddle_ownership_ambiguous_other_wrist_closer') whenever the other wrist is strictly closer than the target wrist but the decisive gate did not fire.
regressionTests: RT-A cases in paddleOwnershipRedTeam.test.ts (default break locked + guarded abstention)

breaks.scenario: paddle handoff between players with missing other-wrist evidence
breaks.break: Track leaves the target's hand and travels 41 observations of other-player geometry, but with no other-wrist measurements the flip segmentation cannot fire; all 41 post-handoff observations are kept as target-owned.
breaks.fix: ownership-guard-v1 drops sustained (>=3) out-of-hand runs that have zero other-wrist evidence, keeping the verified 40-observation in-hand head.

breaks.scenario: target paddle fully occluded; other paddle visible in target's zone
breaks.break: With the other player's wrists unmeasured, an other-owned paddle sitting near the target wrist is selected as confident 'tracked' with zero risks — geometrically indistinguishable from a true target paddle.
breaks.fix: ownership-guard-v1 attaches PADDLE_OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED when other players are present in the scene but other-wrist evidence covers <35% of the selected track. Full abstention here would be blanket abstention (it would also kill every true in-hand track under the same evidence conditions), which the red-team rules forbid; downstream confidence handling must consume the risk.

breaks.scenario: two paddles crossing mid-swing (straight-through and bounce)
breaks.break: NONE FOUND — existing association follows each paddle through a straight-through crossing, and the bounce crossing produces switch events with no wrong-owner tail.
breaks.status: NO BREAK (behavior locked with regression tests)

goldCoverage.method: src/ownershipGuardBench.ts — dev wave-a bundles with committed devin-visual-v2-waveC-ownership.json labels; synthetic candidate tracks threaded through committed label points; real people.json wrists; hit = kept observation within 60ms and 0.05 of a label.
goldCoverage.note: Zero positive-coverage regression from the guard (no blanket abstention). The 4 uncovered gold labels fail identically with the guard OFF (sparse single/duplet labels below track eligibility; pre-existing, not guard-induced).

measurementBoundary: Linux fleet: Apple Vision pose extraction and canonical detector cascade runs are unavailable; no cascade numbers are claimed. Gold replay uses committed labels + committed people.json only.
heldOut: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not read or used.

verification.tests: packages/swing-lab vitest (paddleOwnershipRedTeam.test.ts 11 tests + paddleTracker.test.ts 15 tests, all green; full package suite green)
